main.description: Host-set configuration sidecar for a community.lexicon.calendar.event: capacity, approval, waitlist, and timezone. The community calendar lexicon's rsvpExpected is only a display hint; this carries the host's authoritative intent. Enforcement (the seat decision) is computed by the AppView — see social.scenius.acceptance.

approvalRequired.description: If true, RSVPs are 'requested' until a host confirms; pending requests consume no seat.

waitlistEnabled.description: If true, RSVPs past capacity are waitlisted in arrival order rather than declined.

tzid.description: IANA timezone (e.g. America/Denver) for correct wall-clock rendering across DST. The calendar event stores a UTC instant; this preserves the zone.
